data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 旧唱片的旋律
data.description: 唱片有一点轻微的杂音，她却没有换掉。旋律走到熟悉的一段时，霍尔海雅用指尖轻轻跟着拍了两下。
data.action: 在唱片机旁侧耳听音乐
data.camera: 中景，唱片机在画面一侧
data.promptProse: Sitting comfortably in a velvet armchair beside a vintage brass-horned phonograph in a listening room, Ho'olheyak rests one hand near a spinning vinyl record. A warm table lamp casts golden light across her face and the polished turntable, while stacked record sleeves rest on a credenza under gentle evening ambient light.
